answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require bonded stake: before an agent attests, a staking kernel locks collateral and binds it to one verifiable identity. An attacker who wants a thousand votes must post a thousand separate bonds, so the cost scales linearly with each fake marble added to the registry, while false attestations are slashed. The fable of cheap, endless clones dies because every new identity demands fresh capital that can be forfeited.
